lines.text: Lock on. Shift.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Then hit it.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Red is where it lands. Move, or break it.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The notice drifts down. Nobody has signed it.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Left.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: You saw it late.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Notice! This plate is stamped: INVALID!
lines.direction: calm synthetic, stamped and final

lines.text: A slow belt carries flat, cleared things past the hooks: a hat, a clock, a small bell.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The hooks swing empty. The belt stops with a cleared clock still on it, ticking.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: The Spider Bot folds one leg and holds out a paper. It waits.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Please accept this delivery.
lines.direction: impeccably polite, patient, offers and waits

lines.text: This is your third offer. After this, service is by force.
lines.direction: impeccably polite, patient, offers and waits

lines.text: It's polite. That's the worst of it.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The ink shows nothing, then DENIED. All the forms on the walls turn over at once, blank.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Page turned!
lines.direction: chirpy, bright, fast, like a cheerful appliance

lines.text: Four.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Sealed! Uploading... uploading...
lines.direction: chirpy, bright, fast, like a cheerful appliance

lines.text: They're not chirping right.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Signature... required... uploading... nothing?
lines.direction: low, formal, never angry, only final

lines.text: The stamp prints ADDRESS. Nothing strikes it.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Every lost thing in the Hollow gets a door.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Received.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: TWO DOORS. Slice writes the number twice, one stroke at a time. The second door sits beside the first.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Yours. Next to mine.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: Two lamps come on in the Hollow, side by side. The circle has a neighbour.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Two doors! Two deliveries! Uploading... neighbours!
lines.direction: chirpy, bright, fast, like a cheerful appliance

lines.text: Keep up, Wallit.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: THE LEDGER. One line of writing around the ring, then one door number, in Wallit's own hand.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: One door.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The ledger closes. The ring keeps the one name on it, and Slice keeps the ring.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: THE OPEN DOOR. The slips on the office wall are pinned, every one. Spare stands in the doorway, lid on straight.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Chirp! Everyone is on the books!
lines.direction: chirpy, bright, fast, like a cheerful appliance

lines.text: Brim has an address. Tick keeps the hour. Chime rings once for the right door.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Numbered. All of them.
lines.direction: cool, flat and clipped, almost no emotion; short words

lines.text: The door stays open. Nothing strikes it.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
